text: 中国证券业协会日前向各证券公司下发通知，开展财务数智化应用调研，为行业深化财务数智化建设、提升财务核算质效和推动财务职能升级提供参考。此次调研问卷将财务数智化建设划分为五个依次递进阶段，聚焦六大财务领域，同时把AI相关风险列为重点，做到“提效”与“安全”并重。（中证金牛座）
text_en: The Securities Association of China recently issued a notice to securities companies to conduct a survey on financial digital and intelligent applications, providing reference for the industry to deepen financial digital and intelligent development, improve the quality and efficiency of financial accounting, and promote the upgrading of financial functions. The survey questionnaire divides financial digital and intelligent development into five progressive stages, focuses on six major financial areas, and also lists AI-related risks as a key priority, emphasizing both "efficiency improvement" and "security". (China Securities Journal Bullseye)
